source.locator: Table 6, Exo-REM with extinction by enstatite dust (the dusty model): Teff 1347 +6/-7 K, log g 3.55 +0.06/-0.04 (toward the grid's lower boundary), [Fe/H] 0.06 +0.09/-0.07, C/O 0.75 +0.00/-0.01 (toward the upper boundary), radius 2.03 +/- 0.08, A_V 2.87 +0.36/-0.30, reduced chi-squared 0.757; the plain Exo-REM fit (1049 K, radius 2.32) is the one the paper calls an outlier
